sections.title: Fixed
items: In DEV map trials, an old copy of a battle map is now replaced with the server's version before joining, so you no longer fall from the sky or see flags inside the ground.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: DEV map trials can now use maps generated for real places on the campaign map, each with its own name.

sections.title: New
items: In DEV map trials, clicking Join now downloads a missing battle map first, shows its progress, and then joins.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Joining a DEV map trial without its map no longer crashes the game.

sections.title: New
items: Added DEV groundwork for inspecting generated woodland, highland and river battlefields with separate map downloads. These trials are not enabled for normal campaign battles.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Improved checks that prevent a private map trial from opening with missing or mismatched terrain and spawn data.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Keep empty-server reporting up to date between battles and in the lobby, so automatic DEV updates can safely wait for everyone to leave.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Blocked two unsafe admin equipment actions that could crash a dedicated server.
Fixed equipment-stock updates being held behind other players joining, with better recovery when catalogue updates arrive early or out of order.
Improved recovery for missing uploaded crests and interrupted banner refreshes.

sections.title: Removed
items: Removed an unused older horn package while keeping the new commander horn and animation.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Spread banner refresh work across frames and reduce repeated ladder, history and cosmetic work. Durable battle accounting is preserved; performance gains and gameplay still need confirmation.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed development lobby player reporting so automatic updates can wait until testers have left.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Prepared automatic tester update delivery when new development changes are pushed. Launcher updates still wait for a matching approved build.
Added support for tester updates to wait until development servers are empty before restarting them. Gameplay rules are unchanged.

sections.title: New
items: A detailed ivory war horn with brass fittings and a leather grip is prepared for DEV.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The new horn animation raises the horn, takes a breath, blows with both hands and lowers it smoothly, with corrected hand grips. In-game playback still needs confirmation.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Portable ladders now create less temporary work on the server every moment, while placing and climbing exactly as before. This is a DEV performance update; FPS gains have not been measured.
